prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: one transparent game character battle sprite for a pixel-art deckbuilding game. Make a NEW single full-body sprite of the Eternal Return character in reference image 1. Original outfit, colors, hair, face and signature accessory MUST stay recognizable. Use expressive handheld GBA Pokemon/Moemon battle-sprite pixel craft: a 128 x 160 logical pixel grid enlarged with crisp square pixels, confident dark 1-pixel contours, selective colored interior outlines, 3-4 flat shades per material, deliberate clusters, no smooth airbrush, no anti-aliasing, no blur, no painterly rendering, no doll face. Cute roughly 2.5-head-tall proportions with a VERY LARGE clear head: face is 35-45 logical pixels tall, each eye at least 7 pixels across. Eyelids, brows, iris, nose and mouth must survive display at 128 x 160. One single character, complete feet and weapon, centered with 5% transparent padding, three-quarter front view facing slightly right, dynamic but calm battle-ready stance. Transparent background, no text, no labels, no ground, no shadow rectangle, no scenery. Character-specific face takes priority over a generic cute template.

Character-specific face and pose: Kind young priest, gray-green eyes with softly lowered outer corners, slightly sorrowful brows, gentle small closed smile. Dark center-parted hair.
Original appearance: Neat dark blue-black hair, solemn face, black priest clothes, royal blue stole with gold crosses.
Signature prop: Hold a small gold Christian cross in front of his blue priest stole.
Single face must remain readable at game size; honor the precise individual iris colors, eyelid shape, eyebrow angles and mouth expression above.
processing: Alpha-bound crop, nearest-neighbour resize, transparent padding.
